title: State machine from a spec
prompt: Complete `TollBooth`: constructor sets cars = 0, cash = startingCash. `carPasses()` adds one car and 2 cash, returning 2. Getters are given.

tests.name: toll collected
tests.hint: cars++; cash += 2; return 2; — constructor: this.cars = 0; this.cash = startingCash;
